introHtml: Compass counter mats are built for high-traffic areas where durability and comfort matter. Unlike standard mats, these are designed to withstand constant foot traffic while reducing fatigue for employees standing at counters or registers. With custom imprinting options, you can add your logo in vibrant colors that hold up to daily wear. Ideal for retail stores, restaurants, or reception areas looking to blend branding with practical floor protection.
